description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization dashboard, implementing an Express.js server that loads environment variables, configures database adapters for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB, and exposes API endpoints for database interaction and static file serving.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, defining common interface methods.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL-based databases, providing implementations for executing queries and retrieving table data.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing query execution and schema retrieval.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing query execution and schema retrieval.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing query execution and schema retrieval.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing connection, collection listing, and data retrieval.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of available ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing database operations with error handling.
